component.name: OpenAstroCC
component.summary: Configure Astro A50 Gen 3 headsets on Linux

description.p: OpenAstroCC is an open-source native Linux control panel for the Astro A50 Gen 3 headset and base station. It replaces the Windows-only command center for supported headset settings without requiring proprietary software.

Edit five-band equalizer profiles visually, choose or save EQ presets, adjust microphone and sidetone options, inspect battery and charging status, and back up or restore headset settings. Linux audio setup helps configure separate Game and Voice streams.
